# Demi

> Demi is a TypeScript toolkit for building agents and coding agents: a
> provider-agnostic agent runtime, a sandboxable shell, a transport-neutral
> client/server protocol, and a ready-made coding-agent harness — composable
> packages you assemble into your own app.

The audience is developers (often LLM-assisted) building agents, so the
documentation is shipped LLM-first: this file is the curated index, and
[llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) inlines the complete documentation for ingestion.
Packages depend strictly downward (`utils`/`core` → `provider`/`shell` → `agent` →
`coding-agent`/providers; apps are leaves), enforced by a boundary test. Source is
TypeScript ESM with bundled `.d.ts`; install only the packages you need.

## Packages

- `@demicodes/core`: core data types and shared domain primitives (`Block`, `ModelSelection`, `TokenUsage`, `zeroUsage`).
- `@demicodes/utils`: zero-dependency utilities — type guards, errors, async (`deferred`/`delay`/`waitFor`), bytes, strings, paths, portable JSON codec, id helpers.
- `@demicodes/provider`: the inference contract (`defineProvider`, `run()` → `ProviderEvent`, required `clone()`) plus shared building blocks (`modelSelectionFromCatalog`, HTTP/error helpers, quota, credentials).
- `@demicodes/shell`: sandboxable bash engine and the `Host` contract (`fs`/`process`/`store`); long-running shell control (`shell_exec`/`shell_status`/`yield`).
- `@demicodes/host-local`: Node reference `Host` (`LocalHost`) plus `createLocalAgentServer` with command bridge on by default.
- `@demicodes/agent`: session runtime + transport-neutral `AgentClient`/`AgentServer` protocol (in-process, stdio, WebSocket); `AgentSession.clone()`.
- `@demicodes/coding-agent`: coding-agent harness, commands, and reference resolution (`createCodingAgentHarness`).
- `@demicodes/provider-claude-code`, `@demicodes/provider-codex`, `@demicodes/provider-openai-api`, `@demicodes/provider-anthropic-api`, `@demicodes/provider-grok-build`, `@demicodes/provider-google`: concrete provider adapters.
- `@demicodes/web-ui`: reusable Vue UI consuming an injected `AgentClient` (published as source-form).
- `@demicodes/repl`, `@demicodes/agent-eval`: product leaves (terminal REPL, benchmark harness).

## Guides

- [Add a Provider](docs/guides/add-a-provider.md): implement the `@demicodes/provider` contract for a new inference backend and reuse the shared kit.
- [Implement a Host](docs/guides/implement-a-host.md): back the shell with a remote/container/sandbox filesystem and process model.
- [Embed the UI](docs/guides/embed-the-ui.md): drive a session from your own UI via `AgentClient` and render `Block`s.

## Reference

- [Package boundaries](docs/package-boundaries.md): the enforced dependency graph and per-package public surface.
- [Provider quota](docs/provider-quota.md): unified probe/observe for subscription rate limits.
- [Provider global credentials](docs/provider-global-credentials.md): multi-account pool + global `setActive`.
- [Provider / session clone](docs/provider-session-clone.md): required `.clone()` for isolated forks and compaction.
- [Compaction context cache](docs/compaction-context-cache.md): summary turns via `AgentSession.clone()`.
- [Provider errors & retries](docs/provider-errors-and-retries.md): classified failures and resume recovery.
- [Command bridge](docs/command-bridge.md): LocalHost PATH shims + UDS for agent tools.
- [Shell & yield control](docs/shell-yield-control-plan.md): long-running shell execution, the `/@` command-artifact filesystem, and yield wakeups.
- [Tool rendering spec](docs/tool-rendering-spec.md): how a UI renders the standard tool blocks.
- [Session storage & naming](docs/session-storage-and-naming.md): checkpoint vocabulary, `tool_call.view`, on-disk layout.
- [Action metadata](docs/action-metadata.md): caller-defined metadata on actions.
- [Tool-call concurrency](docs/tool-call-concurrency.md): Claude Code parallel tool batches.
- [Binary stream boundary](docs/binary-stream-boundary.md): addressable binary final streams.
- [Package versioning](docs/package-versioning.md): shared fixed-group versioning.
